rules.description: Every Tier 1 concept has an approved mapping with valid business term
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.concept_mappings WHERE tier = 1 AND (status != 'approved' OR business_term_id IS NULL)
rules.rationale: Exact-match concepts are curated and must all be approved with a business term assignment

rules.description: No concept maps to multiple business terms
rules.sql: SELECT concept, COUNT(DISTINCT business_term_id) as bt_count FROM base.concept_mappings WHERE business_term_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY concept HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT business_term_id) > 1
rules.rationale: Each XBRL concept maps to exactly one canonical business term

rules.description: All confidence scores between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.concept_mappings WHERE confidence < 0.0 OR confidence > 1.0
rules.rationale: Confidence is a probability — must be in [0, 1]

rules.description: Mapped concepts (Tier 1+2) cover >= 25% of raw fact instances
rules.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.tier IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) as coverage_pct FROM raw.xbrl_company_facts r LEFT JOIN base.concept_mappings m ON r.concept = m.concept WHERE r.taxonomy = 'us-gaap'
rules.rationale: 25 canonical business terms cover core financial statement line items. The long tail of 3,000+ XBRL concepts (deferred taxes, lease details, stock compensation, etc.) are valid but not canonical business term material at the Base zone. Actual coverage: 30.0% (163,899 of 545,421 facts). Coverage expands in Consumable zone.

rules.description: Approved mappings have valid business_term_id referencing business glossary
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.concept_mappings WHERE status = 'approved' AND business_term_id IS NULL
rules.rationale: Every approved mapping must point to a real business term

rules.description: Tier 3 concepts have NULL business_term_id, Tier 1+2 have non-NULL business_term_id
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.concept_mappings WHERE (tier = 3 AND business_term_id IS NOT NULL) OR (tier IN (1, 2) AND status = 'approved' AND business_term_id IS NULL)
rules.rationale: EDA: 89.6% Tier 3 with NULL business_term_id, 10.4% Tier 1+2 with non-NULL. These must align exactly. Source: base-zone-eda.md

rules.description: load_date is never null in concept_mappings and audit
rules.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.concept_mappings WHERE load_date IS NULL) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.tag_normalization_audit WHERE load_date IS NULL)
rules.rationale: load_date is a structural system-time column. Source: base-zone-eda.md
